text:
amelia: noticed a failure in the canary image verification during the nightly rollout, cosign verify failed for 2026-03-23 build
sec-bot: [ALERT] cosign verification failed: verification error: signature not found (key id: projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/signing/cryptoKeys/ci-signer) :rotating_light:
david: ugh, is this from the KMS key rotation yesterday?
amelia: possibly — I saw a key rotate but the signer service reported 403s for a ~30m window at 02:10 UTC
sanjay: iirc the operator changed the signer SA's IAM binding to remove 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToVerify' by mistake. can someone paste the terraform change?
olivia: @sanjay i pulled the diff: `resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "signer" { members = ["serviceAccount:svc-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] role = "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier" }` — the new role is `roles/cloudkms.viewer` in the PR, so verification rights got removed
amelia: that matches the 403s in the logs. cosign couldn't fetch public key material from the KMS signer endpoint
david: we need a rollback or add an escape hatch for verification during rollout. current canaries are blocked
oncall: PagerDuty incident created: INC-3118 (runtime-image-verify-failure)
maria: also found an unrelated vuln in the base layer (CVE-2026-1001 glibc) flagged by SCA last night. We should avoid rebuilding unrelated images during the fix window — risk of churn
sanjay: plan: 1) restore correct IAM binding to give svc-signer verify rights 2) re-run cosign verify on canaries 3) if verify passes, continue rollout 4) schedule a controlled rebuild for glibc CVE after rollout
amelia: who can apply the IAM fix? I can do the quick revert if we approve
odavid: iam changes require two approvals in prod. @sanjay can you shepherd and call roll-back PR?
sanjay: submitting PR now to revert to `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` and adding a temporary gating test in the deploy pipeline to fail fast if verification fails
olivia: also please enable more verbose audit logs for KMS and signer service for the 4-hour window post-fix. we need evidence for compliance and postmortem
amelia: copy. I'll create a floater ticket to increase audit retention for that window and tag compliance
sec-bot: audit-log note: KMS Admin API calls 02:05-02:40 UTC show 403s for svc-signer, error: PermissionDenied
david: after IAM revert, run `cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/signing/cryptoKeys/ci-signer@1 <image>` to confirm
amelia: running verify on canary image now...
amelia: output -> `verification error: signature not found` still; logs show cosign is hitting old key version (v1) but signer rotated to v2 last night
sanjay: that implies signer service needs a reconfiguration to point to the new primary key version or we need to re-create a stable alias — we should avoid key version drift during deploys
olivia: do we have a key aliasing strategy? can we use keyRing-level alias?
maria: we use key version aliasing via labels + signer config. looks like the operator rotated keys without updating signer config due to an automation bug
sanjay: ok action: 1) update signer config to point to new primary (svc-signer config bump) 2) validate with cosign verify 3) sign canary images again if needed 4) add a preflight that verifies key-version alignment before rotation
amelia: i'm going to patch signer config and restart its deployment (small rolling restart) — ETA 12 minutes
oncall: oncall acknowledged, pausing non-critical deploys for 30m
sec-bot: note appended to incident INC-3118: KMS rotation + IAM diff removed verifier role; signer config didn't pick up new primary key version
david: after signer restart, re-run `cosign verify` and if still failing, we can do `cosign sign --key k8s://... <image>` to re-sign the canary temporarily while we stabilize
amelia: restart done. monitoring logs...
amelia: cosign verify -> PASS :white_check_mark:
mar ia: nice. please record the signed image digest used for the canary in the incident timeline
amelia: digest recorded: sha256:3f7a8e2b... (INC-3118 timeline)
olivia: follow-ups: - add integ test in CI to detect key-version drift - add RBAC guardrails in terraform plans to block accidental role downgrades - retention policy tweak for KMS audit logs for critical sign operations
sanjay: will own the terraform guardrail PR and the pre-rotation check. aiming EOD for guardrail, next week for CI test
david: i'll own postmortem, include timeline and proposed runbook for KMS rotations and signer config sync
amelia: thanks all. marking incident resolved for now and will keep monitoring next scheduled rotation
sec-bot: incident INC-3118 -> status: mitigated (docs pending).
